sentences.text: 1 5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is the mother-in-law of the O.P. No. 02 and is aged about 73 years.
It is next submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations.
It is also submitted that from perusal of the allegations as alleged in the FIR it would manifest that the allegations against the petitioner are ornamental.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) Adnan/-
